title: Orthopedic consult
synopsis: Reviewed the MRI. Because of an active lifestyle and the meniscus tear, surgery was recommended over rehab alone. Chose a patellar tendon autograft. Three weeks of "prehab" first to reduce swelling and restore range of motion.
report:
## Assessment

Right knee ACL rupture with medial meniscus tear in a 42-year-old recreational athlete. Full extension lacking 5°, flexion 110°, moderate effusion.

## Plan

- Prehab PT 3x/week: effusion control, quad activation, ROM to 0–130.
- ACL reconstruction with bone-patellar tendon-bone autograft and meniscal repair, target mid-April.
- Reviewed risks: infection, stiffness, graft failure (~5%), anterior knee pain.
